scope: EASE ViT-B/16 adapter64, seq-cifar100-224 first task, one epoch, seed1993 repeated measurements

protocol.flops: One separate partial-operator diagnostic run after three measurements
protocol.repeat_policy: Three fresh-process measurement runs with seed1993, then one separate FLOPs pass with the same seed/config; median and min/max report only measurement observations.
protocol.execution_scope: EASE Base64 only; first task, one epoch; after successful measurements and logging verification, local merge into codex/cl-foundation; no remote push.
protocol.precision: FP32, no autocast, CUDA matmul TF32 off; cuDNN deterministic and benchmark disabled, matched native acceptance.
protocol.accuracy_policy: One-epoch pilot accuracy is recorded; twenty-epoch reference margins are not applied. Non-finite or structurally invalid behavior fails.

flops.scope: Partial supported PyTorch operator estimate over initialization, train forward/backward, task-end prototypes, evaluation and diagnostic audits in this separate pass.
flops.limitations: Unsupported/fused operators, optimizer and linear algebra may be omitted; phase FLOPs are not attributed. Not training-only FLOPs. No backward x3 extrapolation.

summary.aggregation_scope: Three measurement passes only; FLOPs-pass time, memory and energy excluded.
summary.accuracy_scope: One-epoch pilot accuracy; the matched twenty-epoch 1.5/3.0pp margins do not apply.

flops.scope: Partial supported PyTorch operator estimate over initialization, train forward/backward, task-end prototypes, evaluation and diagnostic audits in this separate pass.
flops.limitations: Unsupported/fused operators, optimizer and linear algebra may be omitted; phase FLOPs are not attributed. Not training-only FLOPs. No backward x3 extrapolation.

measurement_scope.time: Recorder process window includes startup/import, native W&B initialization, training, prototype completion, evaluation, audits and local output I/O; excludes final W&B artifact upload/finish.
measurement_scope.energy: GPU1 board sensor only; not CPU/RAM/whole-machine. Three measurement runs aggregate; profiler run excluded.
measurement_scope.memory: CUDA allocated/reserved and entire device sensor memory differ. Process-tree RSS sums shared pages repeatedly.
measurement_scope.flops: Separate diagnostic supported operators across initialization/native train forward/backward/optimizer, prototypes, evaluation and audits. Partial count, no phase attribution, not training-only or per-image FLOPs.
measurement_scope.repeat: Same seed and weights in new worker processes; median/min/max describe execution costs, not across-seed accuracy variation. Shared caches already populated.
measurement_scope.validation: Eight structural checks pass per run. 1epoch accuracy does not use20epoch1.5/3.0pp gate. Existing two-task acceptance remains distinct;3+tasks untested.
